execution_gate.reason: Do not deduplicate and do not start the full collection. The reviewed official POWER materials do not expose an authoritative pre-request grid-cell identifier, grid origin/indexing rule, or parameter-complete point-to-cell mapping for these four parameters.

request_reuse.note: The 1,600 district-year request identities are preserved, but their safe many-to-one network mapping is unresolved. Treating all 1,600 as executable would ignore POWER's repeated-cell warning.

storage.raw_policy: Original HTTP response bytes are moved atomically into ignored cache storage only after structural validation.

network_policy.permanent_http_status: Other 4xx responses, including documented 422, stop without retry.
network_policy.retry_after: Honor Retry-After delta-seconds or HTTP-date when present.
network_policy.official_guidance: The official multipoint tutorial says not to exceed five concurrent requests; general guidance warns against too many synchronous requests or repeatedly requesting the same relative grid location. No requests-per-second quota is published there.

resume_behavior: For an authorized request, accept cache only after request fingerprint, byte count, SHA-256 and fresh structural validation match; quarantine corrupt evidence and never overwrite it silently.
